road-to-europe.bandeauLabel: The 10 countries of Road to Europe

pastille.texte: The event that launches your European project

road-to-europe.titre:
Your road to
Europe
starts here.
road-to-europe.accroche: Studies, training, skilled work: in one day, understand the legal pathways to 10 European countries, meet those who train and support, and leave with a clear plan.

pourquoi.intro: Many young people lose time and money for lack of reliable information. Road to Europe gives you the right cards, at the right time.

route.intro: The road takes effort, but it is signposted. At Road to Europe, each step is explained by people who have lived it.

voies.intro: Each pathway has its own conditions, timelines and chances, and they vary from one country to another. Find the one that suits you.

programme.intro: Understand, discuss, practise, meet: you leave with clear answers and useful contacts.

partenaires.intro: Companies, schools, institutions and media: join Road to Europe and meet motivated young people.

parents.titre:
Your trust matters.
Here are our
commitments.
parents.intro: Road to Europe is organised by WAHHF Foundation, an identified and reachable foundation that supports young people in their projects towards Europe.

faq.intro: The questions we are asked most often.

final.titre:
Take the right road
to Europe.
final.intro: Don't let your project wait: book your place and leave{{deVille}} with a plan.

pourquoi.texte: Speakers who know Europe from the inside tell you what works, what it costs and what takes time.

pourquoi.titre: The right steps, one by one
pourquoi.texte: Language, recognition of qualifications, application, visa: you leave with a roadmap for the country that suits you.
Language schools, institutions, support organisations: meet them in person and ask your questions.

pourquoi.titre: Those who left share their stories
pourquoi.texte: Young people already settled in Europe tell their story: the mistakes to avoid, the doors that open.

deroule.texte: Studies, training or work, among 10 countries: find the combination that matches your profile, your level and your budget.
German, Italian, Portuguese, Polish… or English depending on the programme: the language level opens or closes doors. Aim for the right certificate.
Recognised qualifications, official translations, CV and letter in the country's format: a complete file saves months.
Embassy appointment, supporting documents, interview: prepare every detail and avoid the traps.
Housing, enrolment, insurance, the first months: arriving prepared changes everything.

activites.texte: Recognised public universities in 10 countries, with programmes sometimes taught in English and an admission to prepare early.
Learn a trade through work-study, like the Ausbildung in Germany, in care, crafts, hospitality or industry.
Your qualification or experience recognised in the chosen country, so you can work in your field.
The foundation helps you choose the country, prepare the language and build a complete application, with no unknown intermediary.

tempsForts.texte: The legal pathways to the 10 countries, their conditions and timelines, explained simply.
Round tables with trainers, institutions and young people who have already left.
Workshops: application, European-format CV, visa, language.
Schools, institutions and partners at their stands.

soutien.texte: Support the event and gain visibility with motivated young people.
Train, inform and support with us.

promesses: Verified information, with its official sources
Clear prices, paid only through the foundation's official channels
jamais: An admission or a job without any formalities or language level
Hidden fees, or fees paid to an unknown intermediary

faq.question: When and where does Road to Europe take place?
faq.reponse: {{quandOu}} The exact venue and opening time will be announced as soon as they are confirmed.

faq.question: Who is the event for?
faq.reponse: Young people preparing a study, training or work project in Europe, and their parents. No language level is required to attend.

faq.question: How much does entry cost and how do I register?
faq.reponse: {{prix}} Registration is only through the foundation's official channels. Never pay an unknown intermediary for a place.

faq.question: Does attending Road to Europe guarantee me a visa, an admission or a job?
faq.reponse: No. Visas are decided by embassies, admissions by institutions and hiring by employers. We show you the right steps and the right contacts.

faq.question: What language level do I need to leave?
faq.reponse: It depends on the country and the pathway: each country page on the site lists the languages and levels required.

faq.question: Can my company support the event?
faq.reponse: Yes. Write to us from the Take action page or the contact form.
